description: Agent-safe Tableau workbook compiler (.twb/.twbx inspect, lint-gated mutations, bulk calcs, sheet/style clone, template-only dashboards) plus PAT REST bridge for download/publish.
catalog_description: Agent-safe Tableau workbook compiler and REST bridge for Cloud/Server download and publish.

novel_features.name: Lint-gated workbook writes
novel_features.description: Refuse illegal .twb structure (including Ann Jackson bold-enum and missing simple-id failures) before Desktop opens the file.

novel_features.name: YoY calculated-field pack
novel_features.description: Bulk-add CY/PY/Delta/YoY% calculated fields for a measure list without hand-editing XML.

novel_features.name: Template-only dashboard scaffold
novel_features.description: Add dashboards only from known-good layouts (single, two-pane, three-row, quad) or clone — never freeform LLM zone dumps.

novel_features.name: Sheet style mimic
novel_features.description: Copy style subtrees from a known-good worksheet onto others (Ann's successful mimic path).

novel_features.name: REST download/publish bridge
novel_features.description: PAT-authenticated download and publish so agents can round-trip Cloud/Server workbooks through the local compiler.

notes: Workbook engine is hand-built for undocumented .twb structure (Ann Jackson fix). REST companion binary is tableau-rest-pp-cli in cmd/.
